About us

A reference in consulting and technical assistance

OASYS is a consulting and technical assistance firm based in Dakar, Senegal. Since 2009, we identify where development projects need the right expertise, and bring it directly to the governments, NGOs, foundations, and institutions delivering them.

Every engagement starts with the same question: what does this project need to succeed?
